messages.text:
Hey, you!{be01}
Don't smile at my favorite player.{be01}

Ami: Argh! We lost,
and it's your fault.{be01}
Eira: You should try harder.
Don't drag me down.

The only thing we have in common
is that we like the same team.{be01}
But really, isn't that the most
important thing for a fan?

Argh, because of you,
we're in a big pinch.

Our teamwork is sooooo bad,
except when we cheer during games.{be01}
But we really don't care
about any time but game time.

No way! Argh, we are losing
because you are not really trying!
